purpose: Teach: のぞみ/りゅう/秀樹/和彦/優作/三男/英男/誠一

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、新幹線のぞみで関西行ったろ
lines.en: Riku, you took the Nozomi to Kansai, didn't you?
lines.style: Teasing challenge — leans forward slightly. Casual, testing tone. Drawn out on the question mark, like she's enjoying catching him in something.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、隣のクラスのりゅうと仲良いな、桜
lines.en: You're pretty close with Ryuto from the next class, huh, Sakura?
lines.style: Deflecting with a counter-jab. Cool-distant surface. Slightly faster delivery, throwing it back at her before she can land another one.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お父さんが西城秀樹の曲歌ってたな
lines.en: Riku, your dad was singing Hideki Saijo songs the other day.
lines.style: Dry, half-smirk in the voice. Soft eye-roll underneath. Quick tempo — land it and move on. Barely suppressing amusement at his embarrassment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、隣の和彦おじさんと挨拶してたな、桜
lines.en: You were saying hi to Kazuhiko uncle next door, remember?
lines.style: Turnabout — mirroring her rhythm and tone. Same teasing energy. Steady eye contact level. Two can play this game.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お父さん、松田優作の映画を布教してたな
lines.en: Riku, your dad was really pushing that Yusaku Matsuda film on everyone.
lines.style: Observational smirk. Warm underneath the sarcasm — she's not being mean, just noticing. Slightly slower, enjoying the fact that his dad is embarrassingly enthusiastic.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族構成で三男って言ってたよな、桜
lines.en: You mentioned you were the third son in your family, didn't you?
lines.style: Quiet persistence. Not aggressive — just steady. A fact she's remembered and is now using. Slight weight on the question, like she's making a point.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の英男おじさんって面白いな
lines.en: Riku, your Uncle Hideo is pretty funny, though.
lines.style: Genuine shift — the teasing drops slightly. Real curiosity surfaces. Softer attack. Shorter pace. She actually wants to know what he thinks.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、塾の誠一先生厳しかったな、桜
lines.en: Your cram school teacher Seiichi was strict, wasn't he?
lines.style: Wry closing volley. Slight smile in the tone — not mean-spirited. Acknowledging the back-and-forth has been good. Ease up slightly on the defensiveness, let him see she enjoys this.
